question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**pleasant**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage describes the experience of being alone in a carriage in positive terms.
 
• "Pleasant" appropriately describes a positive sense of freedom.
 
• "**Pleasant**" fits well with the overall tone of the passage, which conveys a sense of enjoyment and liberty.
 
• Other options ("**tedious**", "**contemptuous**", "**baleful**") have negative connotations and do not match the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *There is a pleasant__ sense of freedom about being alone in a carriage that is jolting noisily through the night. It is liberty unrestrained in a very (2) ______ form. You can do anything you like. You can talk to (3) ______ as loud as you please and no one will hear you. You can have that argument out with Jones and roll him triumphantly in the dust (4) ________ fear of a counterstroke. You can stand on your head and no one will see you. You can sing or dance a two-step or practise a golf stroke, (5) ______ play marbles on the floor without let or hindrance.* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Tedious:** Incorrect as it implies boredom and does not fit the positive tone of the passage.
 
• **Contemptuous:** Incorrect as it suggests disdain and is not relevant to the context.
 
• **Baleful:** Incorrect as it signifies harm or malice, which is contrary to the positive sentiment conveyed.
